I am running the unit test suite across the modified and new packages and waiting for the results.
I have implemented the `encryption` package and integrated it into the configuration, file naming utilities, and handler pipeline on branch `feat/encryption`:

- **Streaming Encryption & Decryption ([encryption.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hva_9dp/encryption/encryption.go))**:
  - Added [`NewEncryptor`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hva_9dp/encryption/encryption.go#L49-L56) validating 32-byte keys (wrapping [`ErrInvalidKey`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hva_9dp/encryption/encryption.go#L42)).
  - Added [`Encryptor.EncryptWriter`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hva_9dp/encryption/encryption.go#L60-L72) for AES-256-GCM chunked streaming (up to 64KB chunks) with the 3-byte header (`0x4F 0x44 0x01`), 4-byte big-endian chunk length prefixes, unique 12-byte nonces, 4-byte zero sentinel, and trailing 32-byte HMAC-SHA256 over all bytes between the header and sentinel, with idempotent `Close()`.
  - Added [`DecryptReader`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hva_9dp/encryption/encryption.go#L198-L220) with lazy initialization in `Read()` and validation for headers, versions, truncation, keys, and HMAC integrity.
- **Encryption Config & Key Loading ([config.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hva_9dp/encryption/config.go))**:
  - Added [`Config`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hva_9dp/encryption/config.go#L25-L33) and [`Config.Validate`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hva_9dp/encryption/config.go#L76-L81) enforcing case-insensitive key sources (`env`, `file`, `literal`, `derive`) and mutual exclusivity across source-specific fields.
  - Added [`LoadKey`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hva_9dp/encryption/config.go#L134-L179) supporting environment variables, files, inline base64 keys, and PBKDF2-SHA256 key derivation (`>= 16`-byte salt and non-empty passphrase).
- **Job Config, File Suffixes, and Handler Pipeline ([job.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hva_9dp/config/job.go), [filenutil.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hva_9dp/fileutil/filenutil.go), [jobhandler.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hva_9dp/handler/jobhandler.go))**:
  - Added `Encryption` and [`Job.Encrypted`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hva_9dp/config/job.go#L113-L115) to [`config.Job`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hva_9dp/config/job.go#L49-L67), and exported [`Job.Validate`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hva_9dp/config/job.go#L117-L135).
  - Updated [`EnsureFileSuffix`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hva_9dp/fileutil/filenutil.go#L30-L50) and [`EnsureFileName`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hva_9dp/fileutil/filenutil.go#L52-L55) with `shouldEncrypt bool` to append `.enc` after `.gz` idempotently.
  - Updated [`storageReadWriteCloser`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hva_9dp/handler/jobhandler.go#L31-L65) and [`JobHandler.save`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hva_9dp/handler/jobhandler.go#L68-L157) to fail fast on key validation/loading errors before storage operations and stream compressed output through the encryptor.
